name.value: Prestige Hudson Bay Lodge Premier Collection

description.value: Prestige Hudson Bay Lodge & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel situated on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) in Smithers, BC, surrounded by mountain views. The property offers a variety of rooms and suites including new kitchenette units, a recently renovated lobby, fitness room, and convention facilities. It sits minutes from downtown Smithers shops and restaurants, making it a convenient base for touring cyclists passing through the Bulkley Valley.
